review_candidates.description: Real ownership from day one, not check-ins and micromanagement. That's what the Senior OneTrust Platform Configuration Engineer role at Nortal looks like. What Working With Us Looks Like Remote work with a LATAM team. Coffee breaks, tech talks, and games keep it human, even at a distance. No micromanagement. We hire for autonomy and expect you to use it. Support beyond the job. Our People Care team helps with time off, wellness, and anything in between. Our accounts team handles client relationships, so you focus on the work. What You Get Competitive USD salary. Full remote work, with coworking spaces across LATAM if you want to meet the team in person. Paid time off under your country's rules, at full salary. National holidays. Sick leave, no stress attached. A yearly refundable credit. Spend it on anything related to your health and well-being. A day off for your birthday. About This Search Great talent doesn't wait for job postings, so we don't either. We're building a network of skilled professionals for roles that come up regularly with our clients. Join our Future Talent network and you'll be one of the first people we reach when the right opening appears. We make around 160 hires a year, so it happens often. The role As a Senior OneTrust Platform Configuration Engineer, you will help organizations configure and improve OneTrust Data Discovery and Data Catalog capabilities for privacy rights automation. You will bring together OneTrust expertise, data engineering, and privacy requirements to support accurate data inventories and end-to-end data subject request (DSAR) workflows, including identifying and redacting out-of-scope data. You will collaborate with privacy, legal, and technical stakeholders to explain decisions and keep work moving. Your Day-to-day Configure and improve OneTrust Data Discovery and Data Catalog capabilities that support privacy rights automation. Manage DSAR workflows from intake and identity verification through data discovery, response, redaction, and closure. Migrate privacy processes, records, and workflows to OneTrust while preserving relevant history, and support the retirement of legacy privacy platforms. Maintain accurate data catalogs, data maps, and data inventories across enterprise data sources. Review discovered terms and approve or reject them; maintain glossary terms, tags, and attributes. Use ETLs, SQL, and integrations to connect OneTrust with enterprise data sources and support privacy use cases. Take part in Nortal's Technical Interviewer Program, conducting technical interviews for your account and other accounts to help build the teams behind Nortal's growth. What We're Looking For Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or Data Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Deep working knowledge of OneTrust, including Data Discovery and Data Catalog capabilities for privacy rights automation. Experience managing end-to-end DSAR fulfillment, including data discovery and redaction of out-of-scope data. Senior data engineering experience with ETLs, SQL, and integrations across enterprise data sources. Experience migrating privacy processes, records, or workflows to OneTrust. Working knowledge of GDPR and CCPA and how data subject rights apply across enterprise systems. Strong communication skills, including explaining technical and privacy decisions to legal, privacy, and business stakeholders. Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons. How The Process Works Apply and upload your resume. We review your profile and add it to our talent database. We reach out for an interview to learn about your experience and share more about what we're looking for. When a role opens that fits, we contact you to start the process. Because we already know you, it moves faster. No intermediaries. You deal with us directly. About Nortal For over 25 years, we've built the systems that global enterprises and public institutions run on. Today, that means using AI and data to help organizations make better decisions, not just build what they asked for. We believe good solutions don't have to be complicated. That's why our clients trust us with the initiatives that matter most. Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. If that's what you're after, apply now. 👇 By applying to this position, you authorize Nortal to collect, store, transfer, and process your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For more information, please review our Privacy Policy.

review_candidates.company: 北京易点淘网络技术有限公司
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 【企业介绍】 易点云是港股上市的办公IT综合解决方案专家（02416.HK），为全国5万多家企业提供“随用随还”的订阅服务：不用买断，每天不到2块钱，设备坏了2-4小时上门换新。我们的业务覆盖全国百余座城市，拥有超5万家活跃客户，截止2026年Q1在服务设备超过170万台。我们不仅有再制造自研技术及AI检测产线，使得公司能将设备商用寿命延长至10年，更有自研电脑品牌部门，支持自主研发笔记本电脑、一体式电脑和高性能定制机；这些自研设备通过我们的订阅平台+IT托管服务，直接送进千万企业的办公室！ 【部门介绍】 客户满意中心是易点云全域客户体验中枢、全国IT交付履约总控平台，构筑企业服务核心护城河。统筹全国线上线下运维网络、服务商生态与售后全链路闭环，制定行业服务标准，把控客户全周期体验与品牌口碑，支撑公司规模扩张与行业核心竞争力打造。 秉持“企业IT问题终结者，7×24小时助力企业IT更轻松”使命，打造在线、远程、现场三位一体专属服务体系，覆盖设备全生命周期技术保障，极致压缩企业IT运维人力、时间、资金综合成本，为千行百业的办公保驾护航。 【岗位职责】 1.上门解决客户报修IT软硬件故障并不断提高现场解决的能力 1)负责在用户现场对计算机软硬件的故障诊断、维修换件、和升级； 2)负责对用户现场打印机等办公外设产品的安装、维护、维修、巡检等工作 3)负责用户现场整体网络及服务器设备的安装、维护、维修、巡检等工作 4)负责用户现场Windows、Mac系列操作系统和客户所有办公软件进行安装、配置、故障调试等工作。 2.上门指导客户签署协议或其他合同，保证协议合同签署真实有效，实地检验客户办公地址，保证上传数据真实； 3.在客户现场服务过程中抚慰客户情绪，增加用户粘性。 【任职要求】 1.优秀的服务意识，卓越的执行力、良好的沟通及应变能力，认真负责的工作态度，团队精神强； 2.具有较强的学习能力和抗压能力； 3.工作态度认真、负责、细致，责任心。 【岗位优势】 1、晋升空间充分，一年4次调薪窗口，晋升通路：运维工程师（8-10k）-网管工程师（10-12k)-网管主管(12-15k)。优秀同学一年可完成对应晋升通路通关。 2、多劳多得，培训标准清晰，主管带教制，新人小白可在两月内上手拿到高薪。 3、团队年轻，氛围好，管理透明无套路。 4、上市公司待遇正规，入职即缴纳五险一金，试用期薪资100%发放，提供餐补和话补，定期团建，开心的赚到钱。 如果你也不甘于拿死工资，动手能力强，喜欢与人沟通交流，希望加入一个喜欢捣鼓设备，热爱IT，在技术上有所成长的平台，欢迎投递简历，我们会尽快和你联系。

review_candidates.description: Department: 61-458 - Technology - Live Operations Location: UK - Leeds Description Why Join DAZN? DAZN is one of the world’s leading sports streaming platforms, delivering live and on-demand content to millions of fans across the globe. In an always-on environment, service continuity is critical. As a Technical Incident Manager, you’ll be at the forefront of restoring services when issues arise, owning the process of critical incident response across our global tech infrastructure. This is your opportunity to directly influence the availability, performance, and integrity of the product used by millions daily. If you're passionate about rapid troubleshooting, operational excellence, and leading under pressure, this is your arena. The Role: As a Technical Incident Manager n our Global Live Operations team, you’ll be responsible for managing all critical technical incidents (S1–S3) across DAZN’s platforms and services. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you’ll lead service restoration efforts, coordinate technical teams, and drive rapid problem resolution while ensuring quality communication with the business. Be part of a 1 in 4 on-call rotation, supporting major live events. You’ll also be instrumental in operationalising new projects, defining monitoring requirements, and ensuring support readiness. You will act as a central figure for all things incident response—partnering across engineering, operations, support, and vendor teams. What You'll Be Doing: Technically lead the resolution of critical incidents, managing SMEs, technical sub-channels, and service restoration efforts. Coordinate with DAZN teams and third-party vendors during incidents via war rooms, Teams channels, and structured communication points. Own the integrity of the Major Incident Management process; ensure SLAs are met and processes followed. Communicate clear and timely updates to business stakeholders, shielding engineering teams for focused restoration. Provide technical guidance and mentorship during incidents, recommending improvements in troubleshooting and tooling. Partner with Dev, Engineering, and Support teams to manage escalations and ensure platform stability. Identify infrastructure, architectural, and process-level improvements to increase uptime and reduce MTTR. Operationalise new features, scope monitoring needs, produce runbooks, and assess delivery risks before launch What You'll Bring: Proven experience managing critical (S1–S3) incidents with a strong track record of resolution leadership. Strong understanding of ITIL practices, including incident, problem, and change management. Ability to lead cross-functional and vendor teams during high-pressure events. Experience with incident data analysis: CS tickets, social media signals, error codes, and playback failures. Familiarity with customer-impact KPIs such as rebuffering rates, playback failures, and capacity alerts. Operations background in a 24/7, 365 support model. Hands-on knowledge of Halo, JIRA, APIs and cloud platforms (ECS, Lambda, cloud-native databases). Experience with observability tools like New Relic, Coralogix, or Conviva. Demonstrated ability to transition complex projects into live environments, including building monitoring, runbooks, and operational frameworks Benefits Benefits include access to DAZN, 25 days’ annual leave (increasing by 3 days after 3 years), private medical insurance, life assurance, pension contributions up to 5%, family friendly community including enhanced parental leave, electric vehicle benefit option, learning and development resources, opportunity for flexible working, and access to our internal speaker series and events.

review_candidates.description: Senior Client Support Specialist Role Overview The Senior Client Support Specialist is a technical support professional who owns complex support cases and client escalations from intake through resolution. Operating as a senior individual contributor in a remote environment, this role partners closely with Client Success, Product, Engineering, Quality, and DevOps teams to protect the client experience, provide timely visibility into issue status, and ensure client feedback informs product and operational improvements. Work location: United States Work arrangement: Remote Employment type: Full time Work schedule: Ability to work overlapping U.S. time zones and support coverage within a five-day, shift-based support model. The current expected schedule is Monday through Friday, 11:00 AM - 8:00 PM Pacific Time. Citizenship and location requirement: This role supports a FedRAMP environment and requires that work be performed within the United States by individuals authorized to work in the U.S. and who are U.S. citizens. Key Responsibilities Own complex client support cases end-to-end, ensuring accurate ticket prioritization, thorough documentation, adherence to response and resolution SLAs, and proactive communication with clients and internal stakeholders. Act as an escalation point for high-impact technical issues, coordinating investigation, mitigation, and resolution across Engineering, Product, Quality, DevOps, and Client Success. Partner with Client Success Managers on strategic and escalated accounts to identify client risk early, track issue status, and support critical accounts. Monitor release and hotfix processes for client-impacting issues, assist with post-release triage, and participate in incident and post-incident root-cause analyses. Identify recurring support themes, product defects, documentation gaps, and usability challenges, translating findings into actionable feedback for Product and Engineering. Author and maintain internal troubleshooting documentation, runbooks, and client-facing knowledge portal content. Analyze support metrics and operational trends—including ticket volume, backlog health, SLA attainment, escalation patterns, defect impact, and bug closure rates—to drive continuous process and service improvements. Leverage AI-native practices, including LLMs, automation, and knowledge retrieval tools, to enhance ticket triage, investigation, documentation, and client communication. Mentor team members on troubleshooting techniques, ticket quality, escalation management, and support processes. Qualifications The hiring organization lists the following preferred qualifications: 8–10 years of experience in technical client support, SaaS support, implementation, or onboarding within a fast-paced, browser-based software organization. Demonstrated success independently managing complex support queues and driving high-priority client issues to timely, high-quality resolution. Strong technical troubleshooting skills across SaaS platforms, browser-based applications, desktop and mobile environments, client data, integrations, and configuration-related issues. Experience leading client escalations and coordinating resolution across Client Success, Product, Engineering, Quality, and DevOps teams. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. A professional, empathetic, and solution-oriented approach to client support, including comfort managing sensitive or high-visibility client situations. Experience using LLMs, automation, and AI-enabled workflows to improve support resolution, knowledge retrieval, documentation, and customer communication. Experience interpreting support data and translating trends into process, documentation, or product improvements. Experience working with distributed teams, including offshore teams. Familiarity with AWS or Google Cloud environments, log monitoring, and Elasticsearch is preferred. Bonus points for knowledge of IT/networking, HTML or web technologies, database structures, APIs, integrations, or identity and access management. Compensation and Benefits Competitive salary Stock options Medical, dental, and vision insurance Health savings account (HSA) contribution 401(k) retirement plan Flexible paid time off and parental leave Company wellness days Learning stipend Home office stipend Home internet reimbursement Mobile phone reimbursement Employment Conditions and Notices All employees are expected to understand and adhere to all organizational security and privacy related policies in order to protect organization data and client data. The organization is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity and does not discriminate based on race, color, sex, national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any factors protected by applicable law. The organization prioritizes the full inclusion of qualified individuals and provides necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.
